author: Good Enough
description:
An ordinary newspaper once concealed one of the strangest tools associated with Cold War espionage.

Designed to look completely harmless, this hidden device could release an almost invisible mist during covert operations without drawing attention. The weapon was created to blend into everyday life, making it difficult for targets to notice anything unusual until it was too late.

This Short explores the unsettling story behind one of the most unusual spy devices ever developed during the Cold War.
